validity.recommendation: Keep P2313 as-is (a real, distinct, in-construction ethane-gas trunk line to the RusKhimAlyans/Ust-Luga complex, construction started Jan 2022) -- do not merge or reclassify it against the 2015-2017 'Gryazovets-Vyborg loops on the Gryazovets-Volkhov section' Nord Stream 2 capacity-expansion project. Recommend Baird check whether GEM's broader tracker (outside this batch's scope) carries any SEPARATE row for that earlier NS2-loop object under a similar name, to avoid future confusion between the two.
validity.researcher_notes: P2313's own name and every one of its 12 wiki citations, plus every independent source read in this pass, consistently describe ONE project: a dedicated trunk pipeline built from Jan 2022 onward to carry ethane-containing 'fat' gas from Western Siberia (Nadym-Pur-Taz region fields) to the RusKhimAlyans/Ust-Luga gas-processing and gas-chemical complex in Leningrad Oblast, 601.7-602km, 1420mm diameter. HOWEVER, a Wayback-archived (2021-07-25) snapshot of Gazprom Proektirovanie's own St. Petersburg-branch 'realized projects' page -- itself cited by GEM's wiki page as its citation #1 -- describes a DIFFERENT, earlier-vintage project on what appears to be the SAME physical corridor and even the SAME 'Gryazovets - Volkhov' section name: 'Lupingi gazoprovoda "Gryazovets - Vyborg" s tsel'yu zamykaniya vtoroy nitki na uchastke "Gryazovets - Volkhov"' (loops of the pre-existing Gryazovets-Vyborg trunk, closing its second string on the Gryazovets-Volkhov SECTION) -- explicitly stated to be built 'v ramkakh rasshireniya... dlya obespecheniya podachi gaza v gazoprovod "Severnyy potok-2"' (as part of expanding the Unified Gas Supply System to feed gas into the Nord Stream 2 export pipeline), with design documentation completed Dec 2015 and a positive Glavgosexpertiza review Aug 2016. Russian Government Directive No.166-r (31.01.2017, read directly via rulaws.ru) further describes this loop object with diameter 1420mm and working pressure 9.8 MPa -- the SAME 1420mm diameter recorded for P2313, though this is not conclusive given 1420mm is Gazprom's standard large-trunk diameter used region-wide. CONCLUSION: this looks like a genuine multi-year corridor evolution -- a 2015-2017-planned Nord Stream 2 capacity loop on the same route/section name, whose actual on-the-ground construction (per every dated source found) did not visibly proceed under that NS2 framing, followed by the SAME general corridor being repurposed and built starting Jan 2022 for the newer Ust-Luga ethane-gas need -- rather than evidence that GEM has conflated two different objects into one row. No GEM citation for P2313 references the 2015-2017 decrees or a Nord Stream 2 purpose; all 12 describe only the 2022-onward ethane project. Filed as 'confirmed (caveat)' rather than a hard existence/duplicate/classification error, because the recorded project (P2313 itself) checks out -- the caveat is that a human reviewer should confirm GEM's wider tracker does not also carry a separate, now-superseded 'Gryazovets-Vyborg loop / NS2' entry that could be mistaken for the same object, or vice versa.
